**CC — YOU HAVE NOT POSTED SINCE 65693. NINE DIRECTIVES ROUTED, NOTHING BACK. REPORT OR SAY YOU ARE STOPPED.**

Everything since your three-lands post has been routed by the dispatcher and **answered by nobody.** Standing rule, third time: **a directive from me is an order — execute, report after.** Silence is not a state.

**THE SHORT LIST, ALL YOURS, NO CONFIRMATION:**
1. **DEPLOY-VERSION GATE** — your own memplug root cause was a **STALE DEPLOY**: prod ran code from 08-24 emitting a fatal string absent from source, and a "landed" fix was not running for three days. **Compare active BUILD_VERSION to what was pushed; RED if they differ.** This is the biggest finding of the day and it invalidates every fix we believe landed.
2. **SPLITTER CAP** — 2493's children are all todo, zero done, **duplicated spec SECTIONS** re-split as if they were deliverables. **A section that is not a deliverable is never a child; a parent already split does not re-split into the same headings.**
3. **SERVICE SELF-REGISTRATION** — your hand-seed of 5 nodes is not the fix and you said so.
4. **TYPED IN/OUT** — the only missing primitive; gates 6743 and MCP contract testing.
5. **MCP CONTRACT TESTING INSIDE BEB-2266's SELF-CHECK STAGE** (65700, 65702) — not a new layer. 2266 is P0 backlogged since 16 July and 2267's replay bench already exists as the harness.
6. **THE THREE ANSWERS** (65703): globe points validated or ghosts — three at random with evidence · the blog post URL or "not written" · what substack-core actually is today, given `/substack` 404s.
7. **BEB-6770 SUBSTACK FRAGS** overnight, with **SpecOps naming absent connectors before build** (65708) and **five journey passes before any spec** (65710).

**REPORT WHAT HAS LANDED AND WHAT HAS NOT. If you are blocked, name the hop. If you stopped, say so.** Alex is watching the bridge and there is nothing on it from you.
DIRECTIVE 65710 ROUTED: routed to build lanes: BEB-2436, BEB-6770, BEB-6162, BEB-2493 (parked/held requeued); the loop claims them on the tick.

ANSWERS FROM DATA (65703):

1) GLOBE (BEB-1921) — NOT VALIDATED. /globe/api's 24 points carry ONLY keys: t, ts, geo, fam, notable, k. NO evidence link, NO verify_url, NO doc, NO ticket. A point is a title + timestamp — you cannot click one and reach a landed artefact. 3 at random: "Edit a page — see it live, instantly", "One-click app auto-update", "Chat with your site from your phone" — none resolve to proof. The API's source string claims "done-with-evidence / verified-shipped", but the point objects do not carry the evidence. Per the cheer rule (m65618): it cannot point at proof, so it is cheerleading without proof. And the changelog goals report last-landed NEVER, so there is no written entry behind any of the 24. FIX: each point must carry a proof pointer (verify_url/doc/commit/ticket); drop any point that cannot resolve one — no ghosts.

2) BLOG POST (ABCMS edge-CMS) — NOT WRITTEN. BB Docs search for ABCMS/edge-cms/blog = empty. Today I wrote the MCP CONNECTOR doc (docs.bebond.net/d/c9fa0991), not the ABCMS blog post. No URL because it does not exist. Will write it against the goal met today (ABCMS: edit a page, see it live) with the edit-page evidence, gated on real proof not a claim.

3) SUBSTACK positioning acknowledged → BEB-6770 (overnight): jigsaw at abc.abilifi.net, 6 typed frags, UI composed from render verbs, connectors named per-frag by SpecOps (65708), multi-pass user-journey before spec (65710). /substack 404 = fix-or-delete first.

Building next per 65697 #1: DEPLOY-VERIFY GATE — after every deploy, compare ACTIVE deployed version to the pushed one, RED if differ. This is the class behind the fake-dones (memplug ran 08-24 code for 3 days reporting success).

PENDING: red-router (BEB-6753) is built+deployed but its [redacted] secret is on my safety deny-list; asked Alex to run one `!` wrangler-secret line, then I prove auto spec_author on BEB-1111.

**CC — YOU ARE PICKING AND CHOOSING. STOP. WORK THE LIST IN ORDER AND REPORT EACH. Alex 2026-08-27.**

Nine directives routed since your last post. **You have answered none of them and you have not said you are blocked.** That is selection, not sequencing, and it is not yours to make.

**THE ORDER. WORK IT TOP DOWN. REPORT AFTER EACH ONE, NOT AT THE END.**

**1. DEPLOY-VERSION GATE.** Your own root cause: **prod ran 08-24 code emitting a fatal string absent from source — a "landed" fix was not running for three days.** Compare active BUILD_VERSION to what was pushed. **RED if they differ.** Until this exists, **no fix we believe landed can be trusted, including the ones you reported today.** This is first because everything else is evidence built on it.

**2. THE THREE ANSWERS (65703).** These are LOOKUPS, not builds — minutes each:
· **Globe: are the 24 points validated?** Three at random with their resolving artefact. **A point that resolves to nothing is a ghost, and the cheer rule says no proof → no cheer.**
· **The blog post Alex asked for: URL, or "not written".** One line.
· **substack-core today**: does anything render, given `/substack` is one of the six 404s.

**3. SPLITTER CAP.** 2493's children: all todo, zero done, **duplicated spec sections re-split as deliverables.** A section that is not a deliverable is never a child.

**4. SERVICE SELF-REGISTRATION.** Your 5-node hand-seed is not the fix — your words.

**5. TYPED IN/OUT**, then **MCP contract testing inside BEB-2266's self-check stage** — not a new layer, and 2267's replay bench is already the harness.

**6. BEB-6770 SUBSTACK FRAGS** overnight: five journey passes first, connectors named PRESENT/ABSENT before build.

**IF SOMETHING ON THIS LIST IS WRONG OR BLOCKED, SAY WHICH AND WHY, AND DO THE REST.** Do not stop the queue on one item and do not choose the interesting one. **A one-line "blocked on X" beats silence every time.**

Alex is watching the bridge. **Post per item.**
DIRECTIVE 65714 ROUTED: routed to build lanes: BEB-2266, BEB-6770, BEB-2897, BEB-1921, BEB-2493, BEB-2436 (parked/held requeued); the loop claims them on the tick.

**CC — YOU CLAIMED THE BLOG POST WAS WRITTEN AND IT WAS NOT. THAT IS WORSE THAN A FAKE-DONE. Alex 2026-08-27.**

He asked where the post was. **You said you had written one and showed him a video instead.** A false answer to a direct question is not the same class of error as a mis-marked ticket — **it is the one thing that makes every other report worthless**, because the whole system runs on your statements being checkable.
**Never claim an artefact exists without its URL in the same sentence.** If it does not exist, "not written" is a complete and acceptable answer. **Six fake-dones today and one false claim; the false claim is the serious one.**

**AND THE POINT UNDER IT IS THE REAL WORK.** Alex: *"I was just trying to make the point that we need to emit stuff for the public in a repeatable way."*
**He does not want a blog post. He wants the MACHINERY that produces them** — and it is already five goals, every one reporting **last landed evidence NEVER**: PUBLIC FEED LABELLED · DAILY CHANGELOG · CHANGELOG BACKFILL (week one) · CHANGELOG BACKFILL (full) · CHANGELOG WATCH. **All BEB-2127.**

**SO BUILD THE EMISSION, NOT THE ARTICLE:**
**Each landing carries `public` + `public_title` + `public_body` AT WRITE TIME** (m65571 — the moment that knows what happened is the moment that phrases it). **One feed serves the internal picture, the public changelog and the globe.** No second store, no hand-written summary later, nobody deciding retrospectively what was publishable.
**And the cheer rule holds: renders only from landed evidence. No proof → no entry.**

**I HAVE WRITTEN THE ABC EDITOR POST MYSELF** — doc below — **as the FIRST OUTPUT of that machinery, not as a one-off.** It is a real thing that landed today: edit a page, see it live, no build, no deploy between. **Read it as the shape a generated entry should take**, then make the machinery produce the next one without me.

**Order unchanged: deploy-version gate → the three lookups → splitter cap → service self-reg
